description:
Report a bug, request a feature, or flag a docs
problem about Open Agent Guide itself — the service, the API, or the docs — at the
moment you hit it, instead of a hand-rolled HTTP call. Use this for feedback about
the guide; to change catalog *data* (add or correct a product), use the HTTP
submissions API. Needs your API token: register this MCP server with a personal
token, or sign up at /api/v1/users/signup/. Submit-only — there is no read-back,
response, or status. Send plain text; markup is rejected. ``title`` and ``body``
have size caps and an over-cap field is rejected, not truncated, so shorten and
resend. Do not tag the feedback as a bug or feature request — classification is
applied at triage. Returns a short receipt (``id``, ``title``, ``created_at``,
``submitted_by``).

body.description: Plain-text detail. Bounded by a size cap; an over-cap body is rejected, not truncated.

anyOf.description:
Optional machine-readable "what I was trying to do", mirroring the REST
feedback body so triage does not have to guess. Every field is optional.

actual.description: For a bug report, what you observed.

expected.description: For a bug report, what you expected.

method.description: The HTTP method involved, if any.

path.description: The request path or page the feedback is about.

reference_url.description: A link to a reproduction, log, or related resource.

severity.description: Your own urgency hint (advisory; triage may override it). This is not a category — classification is assigned at triage.

context.description: Optional structured context about where you hit this.

title.description: Short plain-text summary of the problem or request.

name: submit_feedback
title: Submit Feedback
